articles.title: US inmate Christa Pike says she woke up 'confused and in pain' after failed execution
articles.description: It is Pike's first public statement since she survived an execution attempt by lethal injection in September.
articles.titleJa: 米国人受刑者クリスタ・パイク、失敗した死刑執行後に「混乱し、痛みを感じた」と語る
articles.summary: 米国人受刑者のクリスタ・パイクは、失敗した薬物による死刑執行後に「混乱し、痛みを感じた」と語った。これは、彼女が9月の執行を生き延びて以来、初めての公式声明である。

articles.title: Residents leave devastated Russian-occupied Oleshky as evacuation corridor opens
articles.description: Several hundred people are understood to have decided to stay in the frontline town, despite the lack of gas, electricity and running water.
articles.titleJa: 荒廃したロシア占領下のオレシュキから住民が避難回廊開通で退去
articles.summary: ロシア占領下のウクライナ・オレシュキで避難回廊が開通し、住民が町を離れた。ガス、電気、水道がないにもかかわらず、数百人が留まることを決めたという。

articles.title: Prominent Russian newspaper shuts down under pressure from authorities
articles.description: Novaya Gazeta has been one of the most high-profile independent news outlets in Russia over the last three decades.
articles.titleJa: ロシアの著名紙が当局からの圧力により閉鎖
articles.summary: ロシアの著名な独立系新聞「ノーヴァヤ・ガゼータ」が、当局からの圧力により閉鎖された。同紙は過去30年間、ロシアで最も注目される独立系ニュース媒体の一つだった。

articles.title: Spain transport minister says he won't resign over high-speed rail disaster
articles.description: Óscar Puente has been facing calls to resign after two high-speed trains collided earlier in the week, killing at least 69 people.
articles.titleJa: スペイン運輸大臣、高速鉄道事故を巡る辞任要求を拒否
articles.summary: スペインのオスカル・プエンテ運輸大臣は、先週発生し69人以上が死亡した高速列車衝突事故を巡る辞任要求を拒否した。

articles.title: Pope Leo XIV becomes first pontiff to vote in a US election
articles.description: The Chicago-born pontiff, who has a tense relationship with Trump, mailed in a ballot for the midterm elections that will decide control of the US Congress.
articles.titleJa: レオ14世教皇、米国選挙で初の投票
articles.summary: レオ14世教皇（シカゴ生まれ）が、米国中間選挙で投票し、史上初めて米国選挙で投票した教皇となった。トランプ氏との関係は緊張しているという。

articles.title: US tech stocks see sharp falls over AI cost fears
articles.description: Shares in Intel continue to fall while the tech-heavy Nasdaq opens at its lowest level in more than two months.
articles.titleJa: AIコスト懸念で米国テクノロジー株が急落
articles.summary: 米国のテクノロジー株が、AIコストへの懸念から急落した。インテルの株価は下落を続け、ハイテク株の多いナスダックは2カ月ぶりの安値で取引を開始した。

articles.title: Democratic senator blames Egypt press crackdown on US military aid decision
articles.description: Chris Murphy said waiving a human rights condition on aid paved the way for arrests of journalists.
articles.titleJa: 民主党上院議員、エジプトの報道弾圧を米国軍事援助決定のせいだと非難
articles.summary: 民主党のクリス・マーフィー上院議員は、エジプトでの報道弾圧は、米国がエジプトへの軍事援助における人権条件を免除したことが原因だと非難した。

articles.title: Mushroom murderer fails to overturn convictions in Australian court challenge
articles.description: Erin Patterson argued her trial was unfair due to seven grounds but three appeal judges dismissed them all.
articles.titleJa: キノコ殺人犯、オーストラリアの法廷で有罪判決の覆しに失敗
articles.summary: エリン・パターソンは裁判が不公平だったと主張したが、控訴審の3人の裁判官は全ての異議を棄却した。

articles.title: Syrians struggle with soaring prices as crisis challenges post-Assad recovery
articles.description: End of subsidies and rising prices drive discontent, testing support for Ahmed al-Sharaa's government.
articles.titleJa: シリア人、高騰する物価に苦しみ、危機がアサド後の復興を試す
articles.summary: シリアでは、補助金終了と物価上昇により国民の不満が高まり、アフマド・アル・シャアラー政権への支持が試されている。

articles.title: Alaska Senate candidate denies knowing about alleged plot to put two Dan Sullivans on ballot
articles.description: Dan S Sullivan, the incumbent Republican senator running for re-election, and allies have accused the Democrats of trying to confuse voters by recruiting Dan J Sullivan to also stand in the race.
articles.titleJa: アラスカ上院候補、2人のダン・サリバンを投票用紙に載せる陰謀について知らないと否定
articles.summary: アラスカ上院候補が、投票者を混乱させるため2人のダン・サリバンを投票用紙に載せるという陰謀を知らないと否定。民主党が有権者混同を狙ったと共和党が非難。

articles.title: US midterms: Pope Leo XIV casts vote by mail
articles.description: As a US citizen, Pope Leo XIV is eligible to vote in US elections and has made use of that right with a postal ballot ahead of Tuesday's midterms. The pontiff, a Chicago native, did not reveal who he voted for.
articles.titleJa: 米中間選挙：レオ14世教皇が郵便投票
articles.summary: レオ14世教皇が米国市民として中間選挙で郵便投票を行った。シカゴ出身の教皇は投票先を明らかにしなかった。

articles.title: Binance crypto exchange suspends trades over North Korea-linked hack
articles.description: Crypto platform Binance has suspended trading following a suspected hack now linked to North Korea. The disruption has left users unable to trade on the cryptocurrency platform while the suspected breach is investigated.
articles.titleJa: バイナンス、北朝鮮関連ハッキングで取引停止
articles.summary: 暗号資産取引所バイナンスが北朝鮮関連とみられるハッキングを受け、取引を停止。ユーザーは取引ができず、現在調査中。

articles.title: Germany news: Merz hopes for Korean reunification at DMZ
articles.description: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has expressed hope for Korean reunification during a visit to the heavily fortified border. Meanwhile, President Steinmeier has held talks with China's Xi Jinping in Beijing. DW has more.
articles.titleJa: ドイツニュース：メルツ独首相、DMZで朝鮮半島統一に希望表明
articles.summary: メルツ独首相が非武装地帯訪問中に朝鮮半島統一への希望を表明。一方、シュタインマイヤー独大統領は北京で習近平国家主席と会談した。

articles.title: Seoul fears being sidelined as US reaches out to North Korea
articles.description: With ties between South Korea and the Trump administration strained, the South Korean government worries that Donald Trump's pursuit of a diplomatic breakthrough with Kim Jong Un may come at Seoul's expense.
articles.titleJa: 米朝対話進展で韓国が蚊帳の外に置かれることをソウルが懸念
articles.summary: 米韓関係が緊張する中、トランプ政権の対北朝鮮外交が韓国の不利益になると韓国政府は懸念している。

articles.title: Bollywood and the underworld — together in the spotlight?
articles.description: A wave of shootings and extortion threats has rattled India's film industry. This time, those claiming responsibility are very different from the Mumbai underworld that had Bollywood in its grip back in the 1990s.
articles.titleJa: ボリウッドと裏社会 — 再び脚光を浴びるか？
articles.summary: インド映画界で銃撃や恐喝が相次ぎ、緊張が高まっている。責任を主張する組織は1990年代のムンバイの裏社会とは異なるとされる。

articles.title: Bayern Munich's Kenya friendly highlights Africa's growing pull for global sport
articles.description: Bayern Munich are to open Nairobi's new Raila Odinga International Stadium against Ajax as Kenya prepares for AFCON 2027. The match highlights Africa's growing sports ambitions — and questions over cost and legacy.
articles.titleJa: バイエルン・ミュンヘンのケニア親善試合がアフリカのスポーツへの関心の高まりを示す
articles.summary: バイエルン・ミュンヘンがナイロビの新スタジアム開場試合でアヤックスと対戦。ケニアはAFCON 2027を控え、アフリカのスポーツへの野心の高まりと課題が浮き彫りとなった。

articles.title: Italy: Students and workers rally over living costs
articles.description: Students and workers have marched across Italy for more school funding and relief from rising living costs. The rallies follow weeks of school occupations and protests against higher military spending.
articles.titleJa: イタリア：学生と労働者が生活費高騰に対し抗議デモ
articles.summary: イタリア全土で学生と労働者が学校予算と生活費高騰への支援を求めデモを行った。軍事費増大への抗議や学校占拠が先行していた。

articles.title: Germany takes cautious approach on Israeli election results
articles.description: German politicians have been slow to respond as they wait to see who is likely to comprise the next coalition. Many are also hoping for a government without religious hardliners.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ、イスラエル選挙結果に対し慎重な姿勢
articles.summary: ドイツの政治家たちは、次期連立政権の構成を慎重に見守っている。多くの関係者は、宗教的強硬派がいない政権を望んでいる。

articles.title: Russia: Critical newspaper 'Novaya Gazeta' to close
articles.description: "Novaya Gazeta," one of the last remaining independent, critical media outlets in Russia, has announced it is closing under pressure from state authorities. Meanwhile, in Ukraine, evacuations have begun in Oleshky.
articles.titleJa: ロシア：批判的報道の新聞「ノーヴァヤ・ガゼータ」が廃刊へ
articles.summary: ロシアの独立系批判的報道機関「ノーヴァヤ・ガゼータ」が政府当局からの圧力により廃刊を発表。一方、ウクライナのオレシュキーでは避難が始まった。

articles.title: Brazil's new anti-gang law: Can it curb organized crime?
articles.description: A tough stance against organized crime? One year after a massacre that left more than 130 people dead, a new law aims to crack down on drug cartels in Rio's favelas.
articles.titleJa: ブラジルの新ギャング対策法：組織犯罪を抑制できるか？
articles.summary: ブラジルで新たな組織犯罪対策法が施行。130人以上が死亡した虐殺事件から1年、リオのファベーラにおける麻薬カルテル取り締まりを目指す。

articles.title: Sinkholes, scarred land and scapegoats: the scourge of illegal gold mining in Johannesburg
articles.description:
There is no end in sight for the drivers of illegal mining, while police action appears ineffective
Cora Bailey has been encountering illegal miners ever since she first started treating injured animals in the townships around Roodepoort, west of Johannesburg, in 1991. But as the price of gold has soared, so too has activity in the abandoned mine shafts that mark the area.
In late September, dozens of zama zamas – the name given to illegal miners in South Africa, meaning roughly “to take a chance” in Zulu – arrived to dig for gold across the dirt road from her charity, Claw (Community Led Animal Welfare).
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ヨハネスブルグにおける違法金採掘の災厄：陥没穴、傷ついた土地、そしてスケープゴート
articles.summary: ヨハネスブルグで違法金採掘が横行し、土地の陥没や環境破壊を引き起こしている。ザマ・ザマと呼ばれる採掘者たちの活動が活発化しており、警察の対策は効果がない。地域社会や動物福祉にも影響が出ている。

articles.title: Sudanese diaspora and human rights groups denounce UAE nominee for UN top job
articles.description:
Critics cite Lana Nusseibeh’s denial of accusations the UAE is fuelling Sudan war by supporting paramilitary RSF
Members of the Sudanese diaspora and international human rights monitors have denounced the candidature of an Emirati diplomat for the top job at the UN, citing her denial of accusations that the United Arab Emirates is fuelling the war in Sudan by supporting the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces.
The UAE nominated Lana Nusseibeh last week to replace the UN secretary general, António Guterres, as he finishes his second five-year term ⁠this year, upending a race that had become gridlocked.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: スーダン人離散者と人権団体が国連最高職へのUAE候補者を非難
articles.summary: スーダン人離散者と人権団体が、国連事務総長の後任候補であるUAEのラナ・ヌッセイベ氏の指名を非難している。彼女はUAEがスーダンの紛争を助長しているという疑惑を否定しており、それが批判の理由となっている。

articles.title: Egypt fines prominent editor Lina Attalah and shuts independent news outlet Mada Masr
articles.description:
Warnings of escalating clampdown on press freedom come after Cairo court convicts Attalah of managing an unlicensed website
Lina Attalah, a prominent Egyptian journalist and the editor-in-chief of the news outlet Mada Masr, has been released from detention by Egypt’s authorities and had her website ordered to be shut down by a court amid an intensifying crackdown on independent media in the country.
Attalah was taken briefly into custody after a Cairo court convicted her of managing an unlicensed website, prompting fresh international concerns over press freedom in Egypt.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: エジプトが著名編集者リナ・アタラを罰金処分、独立系ニュースサイトMada Masrを閉鎖
articles.summary: エジプト当局が著名なジャーナリスト、リナ・アタラのウェブサイト閉鎖を命じ、彼女に罰金を科した。これは独立系メディアへの弾圧強化の一環であり、報道の自由への国際的な懸念が表明されている。

articles.title: Africa’s ‘unprecedented’ Ebola outbreak could reach UK, says top health official
articles.description:
Jean Kaseya, of the Africa CDC, warns of the illness spreading like Covid unless more funding is secured to increase preparedness and possible treatment
The “unprecedented” spread of the Ebola outbreak means it could reach the UK and other countries, according to one of Africa’s top health officials.
As the current outbreak reached 10,000 cases, with almost 5,000 deaths, Dr Jean Kaseya, director general of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), compared the outbreak to the Covid pandemic, which first took hold in China before spreading to countries across the world, claiming millions of lives, and ravaging health systems and economies.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アフリカの「前例のない」エボラ出血熱の流行が英国に到達する可能性、トップ保健当局者が警告
articles.summary: アフリカのCDC長官が、エボラ出血熱の「前例のない」拡大により、英国を含む他国に到達する可能性があると警告した。新型コロナ同様の広がりを懸念し、対策資金の確保を急務としている。

articles.title: UK sanctions Sudanese military leaders implicated in El Fasher ‘campaign of rape’
articles.description:
Commanders suspected of sexual violence during the largest and fastest slaughter of civilians in more than 30 years have been subjected to travel ban and asset freeze
Senior Sudanese commanders implicated in a “campaign of rape” have been targeted by the UK on the first anniversary of a mass atrocity that saw tens of thousands of civilians killed over several days.
A year after the fall of El Fasher, the British government said it had sanctioned military leaders from both sides in the country’s ongoing conflict whom it suspected of sexual violence during the siege of the city.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 英国、エル・ファシェルでの「レイプ行為」に関与したスーダン軍指導者を制裁
articles.summary: 英国政府は、スーダンのエル・ファシェルでの「レイプ行為」に関与したとされるスーダン軍指導者たちに対し、渡航禁止と資産凍結の制裁を課した。紛争中の性的暴力への国際的な対応を示している。

articles.title: ‘Amateur morons’: Flávio Bolsonaro’s short-lived ‘president-elect’ claim met with mockery
articles.description:
Brazilian media ridicule defeated candidate over ‘shameful’ absconsion to US and bizarre letter with wrong coat of arms
Flávio Bolsonaro had hoped that by Sunday night people would be calling him the next president of Brazil.
Instead, the far-right politician’s decision to flee to the US after losing the election and – for 58 minutes – to declare himself “Brazil’s true president-elect”, has made him a laughing stock, with Brazilian newspapers and commentators raining a barrage of scornful adjectives down on the conquered candidate.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「素人の愚か者たち」：フラビオ・ボルソナーロの短命に終わった「次期大統領」宣言が嘲笑の的に
articles.summary: ブラジル大統領選で敗北したフラビオ・ボルソナーロ氏が、米国へ逃亡後短時間「真の次期大統領」を自称し、ブラジルメディアから「素人の愚か者」と嘲笑されている。

articles.title: Severe rainfall and flood warnings issued for central Greece and western Turkey
articles.description:
Turkey has been hit by powerful thunderstorms and a fatal tornado this week with more heavy rain expected
Heavy rain and strong winds will continue to affect parts of south-eastern Europe and Turkey over the next few days, as an area of low pressure in the region has allowed for the formation of powerful thunderstorms. During a particularly intense thunderstorm in Antalya, a coastal city in the south-west of Turkey, the formation of a tornado resulted in the deaths of four construction workers on Tuesday. Authorities in Greece and Turkey have released severe rainfall and flooding warnings, as a further 100-150mm (nearly 4-6in) of rain is expected this week in central Greece and western parts of Turkey, with locally higher totals possible.
Travelling eastwards towards south Asia, strong winds and heavy rainfall have swept across the Indian regions of Odisha and Andhra Pradesh as Cyclone Arnab made landfall. With wind gusts in excess of 85mph (140km/h) and rainfall totals in some regions exceeding 200mm, the severe storm has prompted mass evacuations of more than 180,000 people, as well as widespread disruption to energy and transport infrastructure. The cyclone will weaken as it continues to traverse northwards over the coming days, though will continue to deliver heavy rain to parts of northern and central India as it does so.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ギリシャ中部とトルコ西部で大雨・洪水警報が発令
articles.summary: ギリシャ中部とトルコ西部で、今後数日間大雨と強風が予想され、洪水警報が発令された。トルコでは激しい雷雨により竜巻が発生し、4人が死亡。インドでもサイクロンが上陸し、大規模避難とインフラ被害が出ている。

articles.title: Cuts like a knife: Canadian rocker Bryan Adams trolls Trump with new song
articles.description:
Musician wrote a ‘love letter’ to Canada with a new album – and some pointed commentary about the US president
Lake Ontario, the vast body of water that straddles the US-Canada border, has gone by many names over the centuries: Lac Saint-Louis, Lacus Ontarius, Skaniadorio, Cataraqui Lake. But one thing it will never be called, says the Canadian rock star Bryan Adams, is Lake America.
In his new song Lake Ontario, Adams takes aim at the US president, Donald Trump, accusing him of “breaking the peace” between the people who live on the lake’s shores.
The ‘lake of shining waters’ is what the Iroquois called her
It’s a First Nations name – not an executive order.
But things weren’t going his way in Iran
So like a baby tossing the toys from the pram
You can push us to the brink
But where the open road divides
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「ナイフのように切り裂く」：カナダのロッカー、ブライアン・アダムスが新曲でトランプを揶揄
articles.summary: カナダのロック歌手ブライアン・アダムスが新曲「レイク・オンタリオ」で、米大統領ドナルド・トランプを揶揄。カナダへの「ラブレター」として、トランプが平和を乱していると非難。

articles.title: Brazil’s victory for the planet and democracy: seven lessons from Lula’s win
articles.description:
The trouncing of the far right provides a playbook for social and environmental movements in other countries facing elections, including the US, Spain and France

Thank you, Brazil, for demonstrating how the far right can be trounced while protection for the Amazon is strengthened. In a world where nature and democracy appeared to be bleeding out in tandem, voters and forest defenders in this global south powerhouse have shown it is possible to staunch the flow. This should provide much needed inspiration and, more practically, a playbook for social and environmental movements in other countries facing elections, including the US, Spain and France.
The astonishing comeback victory of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Sunday’s presidential runoff against his extreme right challenger Flavío Bolsonaro has brought oceans of rapturous supporters on to the streets, while also thrilling conservationists, climate activists and social justice campaigners across the world.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ブラジルの地球と民主主義の勝利：ルーラ氏の当選から学ぶ7つの教訓
articles.summary: ブラジルのルーラ氏が大統領選で勝利し、地球と民主主義の勝利と称賛されている。極右勢力の敗北は、アマゾン保護強化の機会をもたらし、他国の運動への教訓となる。

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself the ‘leader of Brazil’ after fleeing to Miami
articles.description:
Far-right senator and family land in US after crossing from Brazil into Argentina and then flying via Ecuador
Flávio Bolsonaro declared himself the “true president” of Brazil after losing last Sunday’s presidential election and fleeing to the United States.
After landing on a private jet with his family in Miami, Florida, on Wednesday morning, the far-right senator published the claim in a letter – even though his own party has recognised the legitimate victory of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, as have all of Brazil’s institutions, and international observers who monitored and endorsed the vote.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: フラビオ・ボルソナーロ、マイアミに逃亡後「ブラジルの指導者」を自称
articles.summary: ブラジル大統領選で敗北した極右の上院議員フラビオ・ボルソナーロが、マイアミに逃亡後、「真のブラジル大統領」を自称。しかし、彼の党を含む全機関がルーラ氏の勝利を認めている。

articles.title: Residents leave Russian-occupied Oleshky amid local ceasefire
articles.description: The White House said US first lady Melania Trump helped negotiate the ceasefire and coordinate the humanitarian mission.
articles.titleJa: ロシア占領下のオレシュキー住民、現地停戦中に避難
articles.summary: ロシア占領下のウクライナ・オレシュキーで現地停戦が成立し、住民避難が進む。メラニア・トランプ米元大統領夫人が停戦交渉と人道支援を調整した。

articles.title: EU to fast-track €45 billion for Ukraine amid acute financial crunch
articles.description: In 2027, the EU will provide Ukraine with €32 billion in military aid and €13 billion in budget support. But more funds will be needed as Russia escalates.
articles.titleJa: EU、財政難のウクライナに450億ユーロを迅速供与へ
articles.summary: EUは深刻な財政難に陥るウクライナに対し、2027年までに軍事支援と予算支援として計450億ユーロを迅速に提供する。ロシアのエスカレートにより、さらなる資金が必要となる見込み。

articles.title: Italy on high alert as thousands take the streets in nationwide strike
articles.description: People have taken to the streets again in dozens of Italian cities to protest against the rising cost of living, as part of a general strike called by grassroots unions.
articles.titleJa: イタリア、全国規模のストライキで数千人が街頭に、厳戒態勢
articles.summary: イタリア全土で物価高騰に抗議する全国ストライキが行われ、数千人が街頭に繰り出した。草の根組合が呼びかけたゼネラルストライキにより、イタリアは厳戒態勢にある。

articles.title: Pakistan: Islamabad zoo introduces 'Coffee with Alpaca' attraction
articles.description: Coffee with a side of alpacas? At a zoo near Islamabad, visitors can enjoy drinks and snacks while watching, feeding and petting the animals. The attraction features ten imported alpacas, a first for Pakistan according to the zoo.
articles.titleJa: パキスタン：イスラマバード動物園が「アルパカとコーヒー」アトラクションを導入
articles.summary: パキスタンのイスラマバード近郊の動物園が、国内初となる「アルパカとコーヒー」アトラクションを開始。来園者は、アルパカを鑑賞しながら飲食を楽しめる。

articles.title: Manosphere's impact on boys and men calls for public health action, report warns
articles.description: The ‘manosphere’ is fuelling harmful attitudes and worsening health inequalities among boys and men, prompting calls for a public health response that addresses the root causes of its growing appeal.

Brazil proposed improvements to notifications concerning the non-application of safeguard measures to developing members.

articles.summary: WTOセーフガード措置委員会で、加盟国は39製品に関する措置をレビュー。EUと英国の鉄鋼製品、EUのハイブリッド車輸入調査検討について意見が交わされた。

articles.title: Cotton: Partnership gains traction as WTO members discuss sectoral developments
articles.description: WTO members reviewed global cotton market trends and the path ahead for the cotton sector at meetings in Geneva on 26 October. The meetings follow the marking of World Cotton Day in Uzbekistan earlier this month. Delegations reiterated support for investment in African countries to help them move up the cotton value chain and stressed the vital contribution of cotton to international trade and its potential to foster sustainable development.
articles.titleJa: 綿花：WTO加盟国が部門別動向を議論しパートナーシップが勢いを増す
articles.summary: ジュネーブの会議でWTO加盟国は世界の綿花市場動向を検討。アフリカ諸国への投資支援を改めて表明し、綿花が国際貿易と持続可能な開発に不可欠であると強調した。
